projects.name: wordsworth
projects.goal: A sovereign pipeline that turns large volumes of Dutch government documents into a searchable, privacy-safe corpus with layered, audited de-anonymisation.

phases.name: Proof of concept
phases.summary: ingest, anonymise, search, reversible tokens with grants, the console

phases.name: Pilot: Gooise Meren
phases.summary: one real Woo publication (415 documents) end to end, for a key user

phases.name: Data autonomy
phases.summary: the organisation holds the keys: originals encrypted, rights per group, a separate key service, keys exportable (ADR-0008, ADR-0009)

phases.name: Production
phases.summary: survives a node, NORA-aligned, ready for a first organisation

gap.item: No untokenised names left (names with particles like ter, van der)
A redacted PDF for every reversible document in the dossier
Console for the key user: deleted documents hidden, a dossier home
Readable topics (named by the language model) and search that shows the matching passage
Share from the console with layered anonymisation (a grant at a PPL, the redacted and reveal PDF)
